Our expertise and solutions in analytical instrumentation and systems for a wide range of application areas, makes HORIBA UK the trusted partner of many companies and organisations.

HORIBA UK provides an extensive array of instruments and systems for applications ranging from automotive R&D, process and environmental monitoring, in-vitro medical diagnostics, semiconductor manufacturing and metrology, to a broad range of scientific R&D and QC measurements.
